text: English speaking dentist, helped on the spot. 800 baht for a routine cleaning of the teeth
Very helpful English speaking staff. Great prices
Both the female and male dentists are kind and provide helpful advice before the dental procedure. You can trust them; you won't be disappointed.

The reception staff and the doctor were all lovely and caring, making us feel like family, like we were their grandchildren.

Today I had my wisdom tooth extracted. The incision was very small and painless. The specialist wisdom tooth surgeon was skilled, beautiful, and kind. She explained every step to me, and it was done in about 10 minutes.

The parking lot is the largest compared to other clinics in the city because you can park right at the football field.

P.S. There's a delicious Tokyo-style pancake stall across from the clinic, opening at 11 am.
The doctor is very kind, the atmosphere is pleasant, and the clinic is clean and beautiful.
The doctors here are very kind. Really great.
